title_en: Lowland areas adjacent to three river basins are at risk of flooding
summary_en: KOTA BHARU – Lowland areas near the Kelantan River Basin, Sungai Golok and Sungai Galas, have been identified as flood-prone locations during this year’s Northeast Monsoon (MTL). The Director of the Fire and Rescue Service Malaysia (JBPM) Kelantan Farhan Sufyan Borhan said that all three basins and their surrounding areas are at high risk from flooding.
